Preference.app:title: Tailscale Mode (P2P Mesh & Exit Node)
Preference.app:summary: Decentralized P2P mesh tunneling. Route 4G/5G mobile traffic via home exit node with zero router ports. Mandatory Ed25519 pairing.

Preference.app:title: Shadowsocks / v2rayNG Mode (SOCKS5 Client)
Preference.app:summary: Transparent SOCKS5 client engine. Route traffic through home router or remote VPS proxy. Mandatory user/password authentication.

Preference.app:title: WireGuard Mode (Private VPN Tunnel)
Preference.app:summary: Zero-copy C-kernel encrypted VPN tunnel. Curve25519 key-pair and Pre-Shared Key (PSK) authentication.

Preference.app:title: NetGuard Mode (Local No-Root Firewall)
Preference.app:summary: Per-app and per-packet rule enforcement. Lock rules behind biometric/PIN re-authentication.

Preference.app:title: AdGuard Mode (DNS Proxy & Ad Shield)
Preference.app:summary: System-wide host domain blocking with authenticated DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH).

Preference.app:title: Local Port Mapping & Redirection
Preference.app:summary: Configure port redirection rules to redirect traffic on ports 8080/1080 to specific endpoints.

Preference.app:title: Automated Router Port Mapping (UPnP / NAT-PMP)
Preference.app:summary: 1-Tap router port forwarder. Automatically opens port 1080 on your Wi-Fi router gateway without manual login.

Preference.app:title: Remote Wake-on-LAN (Magic Packet)
Preference.app:summary: Send Magic Packet to wake sleeping home PC/server running exit node or proxy.

EditTextPreference.app:title: Live HTTP PCAP Port
EditTextPreference.app:summary: Stream raw capture packets over local HTTP server endpoint

EditTextPreference.app:title: Remote Exporter Host
EditTextPreference.app:summary: Destination IP or hostname for UDP/TCP live packet stream

EditTextPreference.app:title: Remote Exporter Port
EditTextPreference.app:summary: Destination port for live packet streaming collector
